comment.text: MYOD1 L122 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Lung tumors; Soft tissue tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: softtissue. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
